lessons.title: A garden visitor
lessons.welcome: Our capybara visits a garden. Look for birds and flowers, then try their words in ordinary print.

characters.hint: Memory picture: the small mark near the top can remind you of a bird's eye. This is a remembering aid.

words.translation: A little bird sings in the tree.
We see a bird in flight.

characters.hint: Notice the grass-shaped top of 花. Look at the whole printed character before choosing.

words.translation: We take a walk in the garden.

lessons.title: A shady picnic
lessons.welcome: Our capybara chooses a picnic spot. Notice grass and trees around the path.

characters.hint: Compare 草 and 花: both have a grass-shaped top, but the lower parts differ.

words.translation: We sit on the grass and read.
There is a flock of sheep on the grassland.

characters.hint: Notice 木 on the left of 树. Compare the whole character with 木 and 林.

words.translation: There is a little path beside the grove.

lessons.title: Look closely on the path
lessons.welcome: Our capybara pauses on the path. Look closely at an insect and some stones without disturbing them.

characters.hint: Notice the box crossed by a middle stroke, then look at the strokes beneath it.

words.translation: A bug crawls on a leaf.

characters.hint: Look for a sloping stroke beside the box. Compare 石 carefully with 口.

words.translation: There is a stone beside the little path.
We walk around the pebbles on the ground.
